They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created and used by the [[Gerudo]]. Due to this, [[Gerudo Soldier]]s commonly wield these [[Spear]]s to keep out intruders. Their center of gravity is in their tips, making them difficult for anyone other than skilled Gerudo warriors to use. The following Gerudo wield Gerudo Spears: * [[Babi]] * [[Barta]] * [[Bertri]] * [[Dorrah]] * [[Katta]] * [[Kotta]] * [[Laine]] * [[Lashley]] * [[Leena]] * [[Marta]] * [[Merina]] * [[Ploka]] * [[Reeza]] * [[Ripp]] * [[Smaude]] Being metallic Weapons, Gerudo Spears will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. They are also incapable of burning if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. If they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], Gerudo Spears will sink, but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_029" |Life = 35 |Power = 16 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 15 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 22 |BuyingPrice = 90 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Spear |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Gerudo Spear}} {{Stub|TotK}} Gerudo Spears reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Spear }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} Gerudo Spears appear in {{AoI}}.
